test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 648 545 317 653 476 (Right)

(Example: 697 - first digit = 6, second digit = 9, third digit = 7)

NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the largest number is added to the first digit of smallest number?
solution:
Given: (left) 648 545 317 653 476 (right)

The second digit of the largest number is: 5 (653)

And, 

The first digit of the smallest number is: 3 (317)

So, the addition of the second digit of the largest number and the first digit of the smallest number is:

→ 5 + 3 = 8.

The correct answer is "Option 4".
